subject: Next steps: HIPAA routing & artifact timeline for MediNovo
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@medinovo.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: HIPAA routing & artifact timeline for MediNovo

Thanks again for the time today, Ethan — good to meet the MediNovo security and product leads. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so we can confirm the right deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem) and line up artifacts for your audit: 

Summary from the call:
- Primary requirement: PHI transit + storage for clinical notes and patient messaging.
- Compliance constraints: must have a signed BAA before production, monthly evidence for SOC 2 controls during POC, and a 3-month audit readiness window.
- Preference: pursuing Dedicated capacity first (for predictable throughput), but evaluating Private VPC if the procurement team requests full network isolation.

Immediate asks / open questions for you (so we can prepare the artifact bundle):
1) Can you confirm whether MediNovo will require data-at-rest keys managed in your KMS (bring-your-own-key) or if Redwood-managed keys + HSM is acceptable for the POC?
2) Expected concurrency/peak RPS and typical sequence length (tokens) for your busiest endpoint — affects capacity planning and whether Dedicated burst will be sufficient.
3) Any required evidence beyond SOC 2 Type II report (e.g., pen test summary, data flow diagrams, vendor risk assessment template)?

What we'll deliver from Redwood before the technical review:
- Audit/controls checklist mapped to Hosted/Dedicated/Private (attached: redwood_evidence_checklist.pdf)
- Proposed timeline showing when we can turn up Dedicated capacity and run a compliance handoff
- List of configuration options for BAA/KMS and networking handoffs

Proposed next steps:
- Ethan to share SOC2 report or a link + any vendor risk template (by EOD Monday).
- Redwood (Ben & Soojin) to produce a recommended deployment path and an artifact timeline by Tue morning.
- Schedule a 60-minute technical review with your infra and security team (propose Wed 10am PT) to walk the evidence map and confirm KMS/networking approach.

If that aligns, I'll queue the technical review and Ben will include estimated costs and timeline for a Dedicated pool.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_evidence_checklist.pdf (1 page)
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@medinovo.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: MediNovo Security <security@medinovo.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: HIPAA routing & artifact timeline for MediNovo

Thanks Ava — good summary. A few quick answers and a couple of files attached.

Responses to your asks:
- KMS: For the POC our security team is fine with Redwood-managed keys provided we have explicit CMK export controls in place; long-term we expect to move to BYOK with our cloud KMS. So please list both options in the artifact map.
- Concurrency: Peak is expected ~60 RPS per region during business hours; average request is ~350 tokens. Latency SLO target is p95 < 250ms for short responses; for longer generation we can accept 500ms p95.
- Evidence: We'll need SOC2 Type II report, pen-test summary, network topology diagram, and your artifact showing data flow and retention policy. We can provide our vendor risk template.

Attached: medinovo_security_export.zip (contains vendor_risk_template.docx and infra_network_outline.pdf)

We are leaning Dedicated for initial proof because procurement is sensitive to multi-tenant production for PHI, but if Redwood can clearly show Dedicated + BAA + KMS options that meet our timeline, we'll keep Private VPC as a contingency. Also please include an estimated lead time and cost delta between Dedicated + BAA vs Private VPC.

Happy to take Wed 10am PT for technical review — CC'ing our security lead on a separate calendar invite after this thread.

—Ethan
Ethan Cole
Director of Infrastructure
MediNovo

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@medinovo.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: HIPAA routing & artifact timeline for MediNovo

Ethan — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the archive. We'll review the vendor template and the network outline. A couple notes from our side and the plan I propose: 

High-level plan (what Redwood will produce):
- By Mon COB: security leads will review medinovo_security_export.zip and flag any gaps.
- Tue 09:00 PT: Redwood to deliver a mapped artifact pack that includes SOC2 artifact references, sample pen-test summary (redacted), data flow diagram, and two KMS options (Redwood-managed + BYOK) with implementation notes.
- Wed 10:00 PT: Technical review with MediNovo security + infra to walk the artifact map and confirm Dedicated sizing and network path.

Cost/lead time note: initial estimate — Dedicated pool with BAA: 3 business days to provision after contract + 1 week for baseline evidence handoff; Private VPC/on-prem will add 3-4 weeks for provisioning and networking approval in most procurement cycles. We'll include a detailed delta in the Tue deck.

Can you confirm who from your procurement team will own the BAA execution? That will help us route Legal for the DocuSign flow. I've included a DocuSign placeholder link below; we'll populate once we have the procurement contact.

DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABCDEF-123456

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@medinovo.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: HIPAA routing & artifact timeline for MediNovo

Ethan — quick security mapping ahead of the Wed call so we can focus the session on the true deltas between modes. Uploaded a short evidence map (SOC2-evidence-map.xlsx) to the deck we will send Tue. Key points: 

Artifact mapping (what you asked for -> where Redwood provides it):
- SOC2 Type II report: Redwood will provide latest report + control matrix.
- Pen test summary: redacted executive summary available; full report under NDA if requested.
- Data flow diagram: we'll provide a templated diagram and annotate PHI touchpoints for your infra team.
- KMS options: (1) Redwood-managed keys w/ HSM and Key Usage Logs (fastest), (2) Customer BYOK via AWS KMS/HSM with plumbed rotation and audit events.
- Network & BAA: For Dedicated we provide private peering options and can sign BAA. Private VPC gives you host-level isolation for the inference fleet but requires network approvals and longer lead time.

Suggested agenda for Wed 10am PT technical review (60 min):
1) 10m — Introductions & objectives
2) 20m — Artifact walk-through (SOC2, pen-test, data flow)
3) 15m — Deployment tradeoffs & KMS/network options
4) 10m — Timeline and next actions (who signs BAA, procurement handoffs)
5) 5m — Q/A and immediate blockers

Immediate asks for the Wed call:
- Please share the procurement contact (name + email) so Redwood Legal can pre-populate the BAA DocuSign.
- If you have a preferred point-of-contact for keys (security engineer) please share so we can loop them into the KMS discussion.

I'll be on the call and will bring the artifact matrix; Ben will present cost/timing. Looking forward to the review.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2-evidence-map.xlsx (stub, 3 sheets)
